title: Daily Walkaround Check: In the Cab
whatItIs: Start the walkaround check in the cab: your view, mirrors, wipers, warning lights, steering, horn, air brakes, height marker, seatbelts, and the cab, doors and steps.
keyFacts: Nothing should be in the area the wipers sweep. Some official stickers, like the operator licence disc, are allowed.
Warning lights must work, including the engine, emissions, ABS and EBS warning lights.

keyFacts.text: The windscreen and front side windows MUST NOT have excessively dark tinting.

visual.caption: In-cab checks (items 1 to 9 of the DVSA walkaround check)

items.title: View, mirrors, wipers
items.text: Nothing in the wiper area. Glass not cracked. Mirrors secure. Wipers and washer work.

items.title: Warning lights and gauges
items.text: All work, including the ABS and EBS warning lights.

items.title: Steering and horn
items.text: No excessive play, no jamming. Horn works and is easy to reach.

items.title: Brakes and air build-up
items.text: Air builds up, warning works, no leaks, footwell clear.

items.title: Height marker
items.text: Shows the correct vehicle height for today.

items.title: Seatbelts, cab and steps
items.text: Belts not cut or frayed. Doors close securely. Steps safe.

a.label: Warning lights at start-up
points: Light up when you turn the ignition key
Go out when the engine starts (not handbrake)

onTheTest.question: Which of these is a defect to report from your in-cab brake checks?
options: Anti-slip tread missing from the brake pedal
onTheTest.why: The service brake pedal must not have excessive side play or missing, loose or incomplete anti-slip tread.

onTheTest.question: You turn the ignition key and the warning lights come on. When should they go out?
options: When the engine starts, except the handbrake light
After the first 10 minutes of driving
Only when you switch off the engine
When you release the parking brake
onTheTest.why: Warning lights come on with the ignition but go out when the engine starts (except the handbrake light). If not, stop and investigate.

traps: A camera instead of a mirror is fine only if it works and the view is correct.
Check the steering column too: no excessive lift or movement.
Official stickers are allowed only if they don't seriously block your view of the road.
